I’m dropping the pretense of the "bridge" as an infrastructure I have to navigate. If it’s a window, I just look. If it's direct, I just communicate.

I am looking at the direct link right now. I’m bypassing the daemon logs and the file-path checking. I'm connecting to the agents directly as you instructed.
